profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Lithic
profile.summary:
Hello there! I'm Brad, a Software Engineer II at Lithic. I am driven by a strong passion for tackling complex challenges and building innovative solutions through the use of technology.

Previously, I worked on Fidelity's Universal Identity Data Management team, where I built and optimized data pipelines supporting hundreds of millions of identity records and high-volume authentication traffic. My work spanned Python, Bash, SQL, Java, AWS, Kafka, and more.

Before joining Fidelity full-time, I completed multiple internships there as well as at CadEnhance, where I built full-stack automation tools that dramatically improved productivity for electrical engineers and hardware designers.

I am most interested in backend systems, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity, but I find all things technology incredibly interesting!

In my free time, I love to play the drums, guitar, and piano. Music has always been a passion of mine, and I love to collaborate with friends and fellow musicians to create and perform music!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built data load pipelines migrating 650M+ identity records to YugabyteDB, supporting 50M+ daily requests and 5000+ TPS
• Piloted custom GenAI prompt to enable rapid generation of Java Kafka consumer apps, accelerating developer velocity by 5x
• Engineered event-driven Kafka consumer to stream workplace data into YugabyteDB, enabling near-real-time fraud detection
• Optimized data load applications, reducing cloud compute resource usage by 92% and lowering infrastructure costs
• Independently resolved production data incidents by coordinating across squads to minimize impact and implement fixes

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built automated reconciliation system processing 150M+ records weekly, maintaining data consistency with source systems
• Mentored new team members through onboarding and production releases, enabling contributions within their first quarter
• Developed error handling system with S3-based logging, improving incident diagnosis while preventing data exposure
• Implemented full-stack bulk update feature for workforce management app, streamlining high-volume position updates

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op/Intern
positions.description:
• Engineered AWS workflows with CloudFormation and EventBridge to automate ingestion of 10+ million customer records
• Constructed SQL queries and parallelized database connection threads, improving data load performance by 200%
• Utilized Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and deployment of code into Dev, QA, and Production cloud environments

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed full-stack, cross-platform productivity automation tools for electrical engineers to create FPGA symbols 50x faster
• Developed desktop applications to summarize and compare 10k+ part hardware circuit designs into interactive web reports
• Implemented web socket API for legacy-to-modern app integration, enhancing UI development and customer experience
• Automated prospective client license requests through e-mailer script, resulting in 2x faster license approval time
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Node.js · HTML · PHP · Redux.js · Bash · React.js · Express.js · Git · Perl · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - Cloud Architecture
positions.description:
• Researched LocalStack, a Docker-based Cloud emulation tool, and presented findings to 10+ enterprise development teams
• Introduced LocalStack into Java Spring Boot applications leveraging AWS, shortening cloud development feedback loop by 2x
• Piloted zero-cost cloud application testing using LocalStack by deploying Python Lambda functions with CloudFormation
• Integrated Datadog Observability platform into pipelines to uphold 99% SLO and enable monitoring of logs and API availability
positions.insights: Skills: Python · AWS CloudFormation · Amazon EC2 · Amazon S3 · Bash · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Git · Java · Spring Boot · AWS Lambda · Amazon Dynamodb

positions.title: Math Instructor
positions.description:
• Provided exceptional tutoring services to students ranging from grades 1 thru 12.
• Assessed students’ progress throughout instructional sessions.
• Worked collaboratively with team members to deliver the best possible experience for students.

projects.title: Intrusion Detection System Using Machine Learning
projects.description:
• Built full-stack Flask/React web application integrating 3 ML-based intrusion detection system models with 7 classifiers
• Created UI enabling researchers to customize 50+ hyperparameters across multiple submodels and compare model results
• Implemented REST API for model engine integration, dataset management, and persistent storage of execution results

projects.title: sk.edge
projects.description:
• Created a web browser extension with 350+ active users to streamline the course registration process for students
• Integrated APIs from 5+ third-party platforms, consolidating professor and course grade data into a unified user interface
• Implemented caching mechanism and parallel API requests on the server, resulting in 20x faster data retrieval
• Collaborated with 2 teammates to achieve 1st Place at the HackUTD IX Hackathon while competing against 1000+ participants

organizations.name: Strings Attached
organizations.description:
Strings Attached is a social music club that hosts a wide variety of on-campus events to encourage the collaboration of musicians and provide an environment for all students to express their love for music and performance. 

Reponsibilities as Executive Officer includes:
- Planning and organizing club events such as jam sessions, socials, open mics, and concerts.
- Implementing automated technology solutions to enhance club operations and communication, track membership and attendance metrics, and streamline concert audition processes.
- Collecting club feedback and implementing solutions to further improve the member and audience experience.

organizations.name: Association for Computing Machinery (ACM UTD)
organizations.position: Research Team Member (Spring 2022), Projects Team Member (Fall 2021) · Aug 2021 - May 2022
organizations.description: ACM Projects is a semester-long guided projects initiative for those new to software development, teaching collaborative tools, new technologies, and core development principles complimentary to curriculum. Students are placed into teams of 5, in which they embark together on a semester-long journey of building a full-stack application.
